name: zeffect_anim_queue_cmd_type1_transform_rot_velocity
description: zEffectAnim::QueueCmdType1TransformRotVelocity queues or dispatches a type-1 activation record containing position, rotation, and velocity parameters.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this activation-record helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zEffect activation/source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja still renders one local stack slot as synthetic queued-record state, but assembly and MLIL agree that it is only the dispatch return-record handoff.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x461970 validates bound-node token lookup, queue and dispatch gating from entry flags and global enable flags, AllocActivationRecord, commandType=1, strncpy of the 32-byte animation name, nodeToken storage, params[0..8] receiving position, rotation, and velocity floats, optional dispatch callback invocation, DiscardLastActivationRecord when not queued, and returning the dispatch record or null.

The native zEffect activation-record smoke verifies disabled queue behavior, queued type-1 record creation after a type-2 record, commandType=1, queue count growth, and the final velocity parameter payload.
